requirements.general_text: Any one of these: Higher School Certificate Level or its Equivalent (STPM and A-Level): Grades BBB or ABC or AAC in 3 subjects: Biology, Chemistry, and Physics or Mathematics, with a minimum grade B in Chemistry. General Certificate of Education Advanced (“A”) Levels: Grades BBB or ABC or AAC in 3 subjects: Biology, Chemistry, and Physics or Mathematics, with a minimum grade B in Chemistry. Matriculation: Grades BBB or ABC or AAC in 3 subjects: Biology, Chemistry, and Physics or Mathematics, with a minimum grade B in Chemistry. Pre-Medical/Pre-Pharmacy Programme or Foundations in Science: Grades BBB or ABC or AAC in 3 subjects: Biology, Chemistry, and Physics or Mathematics, with a minimum grade B in Chemistry. Program must be no less than 1 year and completed in the same institution And Sijil Pelajaran Malaysia (SPM) 5 Bs each in 5 subjects: Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Mathematics or Additional Mathematics, and another subject; or General Certificate of Education Ordinary (“O”) levels 5 Bs each in 5 subjects: Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Mathematics or Additional Mathematics, and another subject; or Unified Examination Certificate (UEC) B4 each in 3 subjects: Biology, Chemistry, Physics, and Advanced Mathematics. Unified Examination Certificate (UEC): B4 each in 5 subjects: Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Advanced Mathematics, and any other subject. Diploma: Diploma in Pharmacy or Diploma in Health Sciences or equivalent with a CGPA of 3.5 (out of 4.0). Course must be no less than 5 semesters or 2½ years and completed in the same institution And Sijil Pelajaran Malaysia (SPM) 2 Bs each in Chemistry and Biology/Physics/Maths and Credits in 3 other subjects, including English. International Qualifications: A minimum of 30 points overall and Minimum score of 5 each in 3 of the following subjects: Biology, Chemistry, and Physics or Mathematics, with a minimum of 2 at Higher Level (HL) and 1 at Standard Level. Monash University Foundation Pre-University Program (MUFY), South Australian Matriculation (SAM), or Australian Matriculation (AUSMAT): Equivalent to an average of 75% for 3 subjects: Biology, Chemistry, and Physics or Mathematics, with a minimum of 75% in Chemistry. Canadian Pre-U (CPU) or Canadian International Matriculation Program (CIMP): Equivalent to an average of 75% for 3 subjects: Biology, Chemistry, and Physics or Mathematics, with a minimum of 75% in Chemistry. All other international qualifications: Equivalent to an average of 75% for 3 subjects: Biology, Chemistry, and Physics or Mathematics, with a minimum of 75% in Chemistry. Other Equivalent Qualifications English Proficiency Requirements: Band 3 in MUET Score of 550 on the TOEFL Band 6.0 in IELTS with a minimum Band 5.5 in each skill (Writing, Reading, Listening, and Speaking).
